settings_kind: Preregistered from-scratch pilot allocation, not a convergence/time/cost estimate. Environment count and save interval match native defaults; mixed initialization and iteration allocation are engineering experiment settings.
continuation_scope: Restore native actor/critic/optimizer/normalization/current iteration. Environment states, adaptive sampling counts and RNG trajectory are not restored; not bitwise continuation and not an independent seed.
stop_rule: If same-protocol GO tracking stagnates or quality regresses after this continuation, do not launch another unchanged extension; inspect training coverage and tracking precision first.
